content.comment_body: Hello, I want to test setting and resetting the output relay in the [product_name] without any programming. I can view the values in the Data Table, but can’t find a way to directly control the output relay in the [product_name]. Does anyone know how to do this? Thanks.
Which [product_name] model are you referring to?

I’m working with [company_name] [product_name] - [article_no], and using [company_name] [product_name] software. I am unable to set and reset the outputs via the software. Although I can see the values, direct control isn’t possible. For instance, check out this example video: '[document] - YouTube'

If there is a program running on the [product_name], you cannot set or reset the physical digital outputs manually. The video only demonstrates how to create a log file to view variable states. Unlike some other controllers, a force function is not available with the [product_name]. If you want to test physical digital outputs directly, you need to remove the program and enable the web server, which then allows you to control the outputs through the web interface.

Hi, [user_name] is correct. When an output is used in the [product_name] program, manual control isn’t possible. Based on my experience, you need to switch the [product_name] to RUN mode, which requires a program to be running. Here's an example of a minimal program to switch the device to RUN mode: If you load this example program, you can then use S7 protocol, Modbus TCP, or the web server to control each output. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report limitations when trying to manually operate output relays of the [product_name] via the [product_name] software interface without programming. The standard software does not permit direct control of physical digital outputs, making the process non-intuitive. Suggested alternatives, like using the web server or employing certain device modes, require extra steps and are less straightforward than force functions available in other controller lines.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to have a simple method to manually set and reset physical output relays on the [product_name] using standard software, avoiding program deletion or complex workarounds.
